Limit of Detection

Limits of detection are often set based on the probability of detection across standard replicates (e.g. detected in 80% of replicates or in 95% of replicates). In this case, we will consider the probability of detection based on if 0, 1, or 2 are the Limit of Blank. The black dashed line indicates that a positive detection was observed in 95% of the replicates. The grey dashed line indicates that a positive detection was observed in 80% of the replicates.

Limit of Quantification

Limits of quantification are often set based on when the coefficient of variation drops below a certain threshold. A common threshold is a CV of 0.35, although I have also seen as low as 0.25.
